column1: # docs/dedupe-audit.md left this open: jibe's view of FedEx carries far more
# postings than FedEx's own Workday boards do, and the reading recorded in
# double_count_test.go was that jibe's index is stale rather than richer. This
# is that measurement, and it is worse than the audit guessed.
# Sample: 2,400 postings drawn from 24 pages spread across the board's 1,383
# ats_code on all 2,400: "fedex-prod-historical-jobs-feed". The board names
# Workday, 66.2% of the board. Checked against FedEx's own CXS API, which is
# the employer's live board: 200 = still listed, 403 = exists but withdrawn,
# 404 = no such requisition. Validated first -- a listed requisition answers 200
# even with a deliberately wrong location segment in the path, and 12 of 12
# requisitions taken straight off the live board answered 200 -- so 403 is not a
#   320 of 320 sampled requisitions answered 403. NONE is live.
# Site totals from FedEx's own Workday, same day (sum 693 live requisitions
# across all 23 sites jibe advertises, against roughly 91,000 Workday-backed
# BrassRing, 10.8% of the board: all five partnerid/siteid gateways jibe points
# at report JobsCount 0 through the same endpoint internal/services/brassring.go
# uses. Taleo, 3.7%: 15 of 15 sampled apply URLs answered 404. Paradox, 17.1%:
# UNVERIFIED -- the endpoint answers 202 with an empty body for a real job_id and
# for a made-up one alike, so it carries no signal without a browser. Relative,
# 2.3%: resolves onto fedex.jibeapply.com, which is behind employee SSO.
# So 80.7% of this board is verifiably delisted work and 17.1% cannot be checked.
